label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterValues flows directly to the HTML sink via encodeForHTML which provides minimal protection against XSS payloads (only encodes < > & "'). The replace operation modifies the string but does not sanitize it effectively, allowing malicious characters to bypass and still cause XSS when rendered in the response.

evidence.note: User input flows through doSomething and is encoded but still vulnerable to XSS
